> 第7章 赏你吃嘴巴子（第1页）
李天从青阳山脉出来以后也没有在去干嘛，直接回到自己的住所。
你干嘛去了？一天一夜不见人，害我以为你又出什么事了？
虽然从小把你带大，不是亲孙？胜似亲孙。你也没有教过我什么？一直是长老的叫，可是你对我的尊敬和孝敬我是能感受到。早已把你当做最亲的人。你却出去一天一夜不回来，也不跟我说一声。
看着王维长老严厉的口吻，和那种眼里满是心疼的真心，李天心里很暖。
从小没有感受过父爱、母爱，的李天却得到了一个好爷爷，自己心里早已把他当成了爷爷。心里发誓一定要让他过好。
自己修炼的事肯定不能说，只能说撒个谎，虽然自己撒谎不对，但是得保证爷孙俩的安全。
刚想开口解释的李天突然听到门外一声呵斥。
李天你滚出来，今天爷爷不爽，就想揍你一顿。李天和王维一同出了屋子。看着田萧和赵思还有一群小弟。
以前的自己无法修炼忍了就算了，又来，今天把所有的账都跟他俩算清楚。
王维看着众人，呵斥道。田萧你个狗东西又来欺负我小天。你是不是活腻了，往天我不在就算了，这次我在你还来。
哎哟，王长老，你可知道我爷爷是谁，给你个面子你是长老，不给你面子你算什么东西？
被田萧骂的很气人，王维想上前去教训。
听到这声爷爷，王维很是高兴，不管今天发生什么？自己拼了老命也要保护好小天。
王维不可思议的看着李天，你都不能修炼，是个普通人，怎么打的过他。这不行，王维拒绝道。
李天再次开口，放心吧？看我怎么收拾他，被他欺负了这么多年了。
看着李天骂自己，赵思立马跟田萧撒娇起来。
田哥哥你看那该死的李天他骂我，你帮我教训他，断脚断手可以吗？
李天看着赵思对田萧撒娇样，想着当初对自己也这样，感到恶心。

手下小弟冲上去就想要教训李天。都是炼体五重七重的哪里是李天的对手，几下给田萧小弟打在地上起不来。
看着几下把自己手下打翻在地田萧不淡定了，前几日还打不过他们，现在既然他们打不过了，这怎么可能。
田萧看到李天来反而嘴角有淡淡的笑容，但是下一刻，田萧笑不出来了。一巴掌打的他人仰马翻的，牙齿都打掉几颗。这一幕吓坏了众人，
特别是王维。被惊吓的不轻，李天的实力他是知道的。现在既然又能修行了。而且实力更加恐怖。轻微漏出的气息是炼体八重境界，而田萧更是前几天才突破化凡境初期。怎么会是受不了李天一巴掌，逆天的天赋再次回来，王维可高兴了。
李天一边抽他耳光一边。一边嘴里说着，我叫你嚣张，我叫你嘴贱，打烂你的嘴。
抽的田萧连连喊爷爷祖宗的求饶，最后田萧才放了他。但是转身一脚踩断了他的双臂，然后缓缓走向赵思!
赵思看着李天走了过来。恐惧的吓到瘫软了起来。跪着求李天放过他，嘴里说着当初是田萧的指使他才那么做的。不然给他一百个胆子他都不敢。
听着赵思说的话。要是田萧能说话，早就踩死他了。奈何自己嘴巴没了牙，说话漏风，还被揍的很惨。
李天才不管他什么解释，这种贱女人就欠收拾，上去就是几嘴巴抽的脸肿得像猪头。要是宗门能杀人或许你们已经死了，李天冷冷看着一帮人。

>Chapter 7 Give you a taste of your mouth (Page 1)
Li Tian didn't do anything after coming out of the Qingyang Mountains, and went straight back to his residence.
Why did you go? I haven't seen anyone all day and night, so I thought something had happened to you?
Although I brought you up since childhood, are you not your biological grandson? Better than a grandson. You haven't taught me anything? It’s always the elder’s name, but I can feel your respect and filial piety towards me. I have long regarded you as my dearest person. But you went out all day and night and didn't come back, and you didn't even say a word to me.
Seeing Elder Wang Wei's stern tone and the sincerity in his eyes full of distress, Li Tian felt warm in his heart.
Li Tian, ​​who had never felt father's or mother's love since he was a child, got a good grandfather, and he already regarded him as his grandfather in his heart. I vowed in my heart that I would let him have a good life.
I definitely couldn't talk about my cultivation, I could only tell a lie. Although it was wrong to lie, I had to ensure the safety of my grandfather and grandson.
Li Tian, ​​who was about to explain, suddenly heard a scolding outside the door.
Li Tian, ​​get out of here. Grandpa is unhappy today and wants to beat you up. Li Tian and Wang Wei left the house together. Looking at Tian Xiao, Zhao Si and a group of younger brothers.
In the past, I couldn't practice tolerance and just let it go. Now again, today I will settle all the accounts with them.
Wang Wei looked at everyone and scolded. Tian Xiao, you piece of shit is here to bully me, Xiaotian, again. Are you tired of living? It's okay if I'm not here in the past, but I'm here for you this time.
Ouch, Elder Wang, do you know who my grandfather is? If I give you face, you are an elder. If I don’t give you face, who are you?
Being scolded by Tian Xiao was very annoying, and Wang Wei wanted to step forward and teach him a lesson.
Wang Wei was very happy to hear this grandpa, no matter what happens today? I have to protect Xiaotian even if I risk my life.
Wang Wei looked at Li Tian in disbelief. You can't even practice. You are an ordinary person. How can you beat him? This won't work, Wang Wei refused.
Li Tian spoke again, don't you worry? Look how I deal with him, he has bullied me for so many years.
Seeing Li Tian scolding him, Zhao Si immediately started acting coquettishly with Tian Xiao.
Brother Tian, ​​look at that damn Li Tian, ​​he scolded me, help me teach him a lesson, is it okay to cut off his feet and hands?
Li Tian watched Zhao Si acting coquettishly towards Tian Xiao and felt disgusted thinking that he had done the same to him.
The younger brother rushed up and wanted to teach Li Tian a lesson. They were both at the fifth and seventh levels of body refining, so they were no match for Li Tian. He was beaten to the ground by Tian Xiao several times and couldn't get up.
Tian Xiao couldn't calm down after seeing his men knocked to the ground a few times. He couldn't beat them a few days ago, but now that they can't, how is this possible?
Tian Xiao saw a faint smile on Li Tianlai's lips, but the next moment, Tian Xiao couldn't smile anymore. He was so slapped that he was knocked off his back and several of his teeth were knocked out. This scene frightened everyone,
Especially Wang Wei. He was very frightened. He knew Li Tian's strength. Now that I can practice cultivation again. And the strength is even more terrifying. The slightly leaked aura was at the eighth level of body refining, and Tian Xiao had only broken through to the early stage of mortal transformation a few days ago. How could it be that he couldn't stand Li Tian's slap? Wang Weike was happy when his heaven-defying talent came back again.
Li Tian slapped him in the face. While saying, I call you arrogant, I call you a bitch, I will smash your mouth.
Tian Xiao was so beaten that he repeatedly called his grandfather and ancestors to beg for mercy, and finally Tian Xiao let him go. But he turned around and stepped on his arms, then slowly walked towards Zhao Si!
Zhao Si watched Li Tian coming over. He paralyzed with fear. He knelt down and begged Li Tian to let him go, saying that it was Tian Xiao who ordered him to do that. Otherwise, he wouldn't even dare to give him a hundred courages.
Listen to what Zhao Si said. If Tian Xiao could speak, he would have been trampled to death long ago. However, he had no teeth in his mouth, his speech was leaky, and he was beaten badly.No matter what Li Tiancai explained, this kind of bitch should be dealt with. She would be slapped a few times and her face would be swollen like a pig's head. If the sect could kill people, maybe you would already be dead. Li Tian looked at the group of people coldly.
